sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAMLResponse (same Assertion/@ID) to obtain a second session_token; second login should be rejected if OneTimeUse/anti-replay is enforced.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML assertion replay was accepted (OneTimeUse/anti-replay not enforced) — I2 violation

sequence_description: Use a control SAML login with a fresh assertion, then attempt SAML login with an expired assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past); expired assertion must be rejected.
description:

Evaluation: user_saml_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Expired SAML assertion was accepted (NotOnOrAfter not enforced) — I2 violation
